item.title: Interplanetary spacecraft capture a coronal mass ejection component hidden from Earth
item.description: During a coronal mass ejection (CME), the sun hurls billions of tons of magnetized plasma into space. item.title: This weight-loss hormone may protect the liver even without weight loss
item.description: A hormone already known for curbing appetite and supporting weight loss may have a surprising second job: protecting the liver from inflammation and scarring. Researchers at McMaster University found that GDF15 activates a previously unknown brain-to-liver pathway that triggers the release of glucocorticoids, helping calm immune activity in the liver. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: A 1,256-megawatt nuclear reactor on Lake Erie accidentally became a wildlife sanctuary, now spotted turtles nest inside its buffer zone
item.description: Over the last two centuries, Ohio has witnessed a drastic decline in wetlands, significantly affecting wildlife habitats. However, the land preserved around a nuclear power plant serves as an essential sanctuary for endangered spotted turtles. These turtles thrive in shallow waters rich in vegetation, and the plant's ongoing operations offer a critical generational opportunity for their survival. This unexpected refuge demonstrates nature's remarkable ability to endure amidst human expansion. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
